summary.en: Prime Minister Shinzo Abe visited Yasukuni Shrine — which enshrines convicted Class-A war criminals — in December 2013, drawing protests from China and South Korea and 'disappointment' from the United States. Cabinet ministers and lawmakers have continued visits and ritual offerings in the years since.
summary.zh: 2013年12月，时任首相安倍晋三参拜供奉有被定罪的甲级战犯的靖国神社，引发中国与韩国抗议、美国表示'失望'。此后阁僚与议员仍持续参拜或供奉祭品。

sources.title: Japan's Shinzo Abe visits Yasukuni WW2 shrine
Statement by Chief Cabinet Secretary Yohei Kono on the 'comfort women' (1993)

headline.zh: 战时强征劳工赔偿争议

summary.en: In October 2018 South Korea's Supreme Court ordered Japanese firms to compensate wartime forced-labour victims. Japan holds that all such claims were 'finally and completely' settled by the 1965 bilateral treaty; the disagreement has strained relations and remains unresolved.
summary.zh: 2018年10月，韩国最高法院判决日本企业须向战时强征劳工受害者赔偿。日方主张相关请求已由1965年双边条约'完全并最终'解决；分歧使两国关系紧张，至今未决。

sources.title: Supreme Court of Korea judgment on wartime forced labour (Nippon Steel case), 30 October 2018
Agreement between Japan and the Republic of Korea concerning the Settlement of Problems in regard to Property and Claims and Economic Co-operation (1965)

headline.en: The 'comfort women' agreement and its aftermath

summary.en: Japan and South Korea reached a 2015 agreement to settle the 'comfort women' issue 'finally and irreversibly', including a Japanese apology and a ¥1 billion fund. Subsequent disputes over its implementation and interpretation, alongside recurring revisionist statements, have left the issue contested.
summary.zh: 2015年，日韩达成协议，称'最终且不可逆'地解决'慰安妇'问题，包含日方道歉及10亿日元基金。此后围绕执行与解读的争议，加之反复出现的修正主义言论，使该问题仍存争议。

sources.title: Announcement by the Foreign Ministers of Japan and the Republic of Korea on the comfort women issue, 28 December 2015
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan

sources.title: Statement by Chief Cabinet Secretary Yohei Kono on the 'comfort women' (1993)

headline.zh: 2022年《国家安全保障战略》与'反击能力'

summary.en: Japan's December 2022 National Security Strategy adopted 'counterstrike' capability and pledged to raise defence spending toward 2% of GDP by 2027. Supporters cite regional threats; critics at home and abroad question whether this remains consistent with the constitution's 'exclusively defensive' posture.
summary.zh: 日本2022年12月《国家安全保障战略》引入'反击能力'，并承诺到2027年将防卫开支提升至GDP的2%。支持者称因应区域威胁；国内外批评者则质疑此举是否仍符合宪法'专守防卫'方针。

headline.zh: 波兰重启二战赔偿索求

summary.en: In September 2022 Poland published a report estimating its wartime losses at roughly €1.3 trillion and formally demanded reparations from Germany. Germany considers the matter legally closed by post-war settlements; the claim remains politically contested and unresolved.
summary.zh: 2022年9月，波兰发布报告，将其战时损失估计约为1.3万亿欧元，并正式向德国提出赔偿要求。德方认为此事已由战后一系列安排在法律上了结；该索求在政治上仍存争议、悬而未决。

sources.title: Report on the Losses Sustained by Poland as a Result of German Aggression and Occupation during the Second World War, 1939–1945 (2022)
sources.publisher: Sejm of the Republic of Poland

headline.en: Greece's WWII reparations and 'occupation loan' claim
headline.zh: 希腊二战赔偿与'占领贷款'诉求

summary.en: In April 2019 the Hellenic Parliament voted to pursue claims against Germany for wartime damages and a forced 'occupation loan'. Germany maintains the reparations question was legally settled, including by the 1990 Two-Plus-Four Treaty; Greece disputes this.
summary.zh: 2019年4月，希腊议会表决决定就战时损失及被迫的'占领贷款'向德国追索。德方主张赔偿问题已在法律上解决（包括通过1990年《最终解决德国问题条约》）；希腊对此有异议。

sources.title: Hellenic Parliament resolution on the claim for German World War II reparations and the occupation loan (2019)
Treaty on the Final Settlement with Respect to Germany (Two Plus Four Treaty, 1990)

headline.zh: 纳粹掠夺艺术品的归还

summary.en: The 2013 discovery of the 'Gurlitt trove' renewed scrutiny of Germany's slow record on returning Nazi-looted art. Despite committing to the 1998 Washington Principles, provenance research and restitution to victims' heirs remain incomplete and are still debated.
summary.zh: 2013年'古尔利特藏品'的发现，再度引发对德国归还纳粹掠夺艺术品进展迟缓的审视。尽管承诺遵守1998年《华盛顿原则》，来源研究与向受害者后人归还仍不彻底，至今存有争论。

sources.title: Washington Conference Principles on Nazi-Confiscated Art (1998)
The Gurlitt trove and the restitution of Nazi-looted art

headline.en: The 'cabinet of shame' and unprosecuted massacres

summary.en: In 1994 investigators found hundreds of files on Nazi-Fascist wartime massacres in Italy that had been deliberately shelved for decades — the 'armadio della vergogna' (cabinet of shame). A later parliamentary inquiry confirmed that many cases were never prosecuted, and Italy is widely seen as never having held a full reckoning comparable to Nuremberg.
summary.zh: 1994年，调查人员发现数百份被刻意封存数十年的纳粹—法西斯战时屠杀档案，即'耻辱之柜'（armadio della vergogna）。此后的议会调查确认许多案件从未被追诉；外界普遍认为意大利从未进行类似纽伦堡的彻底清算。

sources.title: Final report of the Parliamentary Commission of Inquiry into the concealment of files on Nazi-Fascist war crimes ('armadio della vergogna'), Italian Parliament (2006)

headline.en: Contested memory of the foibe killings
headline.zh: 福伊贝惨案的记忆之争

summary.en: Italy established a 'Day of Remembrance' (Giorno del ricordo) in 2004 for victims of the post-war foibe killings and the Istrian-Dalmatian exodus. Historians and neighbouring states dispute how the commemoration is framed politically, and its use in public debate recurs each year.
summary.zh: 意大利于2004年设立'纪念日'（Giorno del ricordo），悼念战后福伊贝惨案遇难者及伊斯特拉—达尔马提亚人外流。历史学者与邻国对该纪念活动的政治框定存有争议，其在公共讨论中的援用每年反复出现。

sources.title: Law No. 92 of 30 March 2004 establishing the 'Giorno del ricordo' (Day of Remembrance), Italian Republic

headline.zh: 对法西斯殖民罪行的清算

summary.en: Italy's Fascist-era colonial violence — including the use of poison gas in Ethiopia (1935–36) — has never been fully acknowledged or compensated. The 2008 Italy–Libya Treaty of Benghazi pledged US$5 billion in part as redress for the colonial period, but recognition and reparations for other victims remain disputed.
summary.zh: 意大利法西斯时期的殖民暴力——包括在埃塞俄比亚使用毒气（1935—36）——从未被充分承认或赔偿。2008年意大利—利比亚《班加西条约》承诺50亿美元，部分作为殖民时期的补偿，但对其他受害者的承认与赔偿仍存争议。

sources.title: Treaty of Friendship, Partnership and Cooperation between Italy and Libya (Benghazi, 2008)
Italian use of chemical weapons in the Second Italo-Ethiopian War (1935–1936)
